# Doit Then 1.0.28
- Unified the selected-date accent and primary-action colors across all six themes. - Improved contrast for buttons, date selection, and Today highlights. - Improved task date-menu hover visibility. - Added Remove Date to the task context-menu calendar when a date is set. - Aligned date removal visibility in the task editor and Quick Add. - Preserved Apple Reminders, Calendar, and Chrome integration.
Companion Chrome extension update: 0.2.3.
